title: From Zero to Three Companies — What Nobody Tells You About Building While Raising Kids
excerpt: Building three companies as a single mom of three daughters taught me things no business book ever could. Here's the unfiltered truth.
body:
Everyone sees the vision board. Nobody sees the 2am spreadsheets while the baby sleeps on your chest.

I'm Lisa Haven — founder of HAVENLY (makeup remover wipes for Gen Z), LUMAPROMPT.AI (premium prompt generator for women), and VIXA (the dating clarity app that gives women their power back). Three companies. Three daughters. One very determined single mom living in Florida and building toward something that would make my girls proud.

## The Lie They Sell You

They sell entrepreneurship like it's a highlight reel. Like one day you wake up, have a brilliant idea, pitch it to investors, and voilà — you're on a Forbes list.

The real version? You're crying in your car after a rejected pitch, eating carnivore meals you prepped on Sunday because there's no time to cook during the week, and FaceTiming your mom at 11pm because she's the only one who still believes in you unconditionally.

**But you do it anyway. That's the whole thing.**

## Why Three?

People ask me why I started three companies at once. Honest answer: each one solves a problem I lived.

HAVENLY came from my obsession with skincare and noticing the wipe market hadn't been touched for Gen Z — the generation that actually cares about ingredients and aesthetic.

LUMAPROMPT came from being frustrated with AI tools that felt built by men, for men, producing outputs that missed the nuance of how women actually think and communicate.

VIXA came from too many conversations with girlfriends — brilliant, successful women — who were completely lost in the mixed signals of modern dating. We deserve clarity, not confusion.

## What Keeps Me Going

My daughters: Valentina (14), Mili (12), and Scarlett (15 months). They are watching everything. The late nights, the discipline, the refusal to quit. I am raising three future bosses, and every choice I make is a lesson they're absorbing.

That Rolls Royce isn't just a car. It's a symbol I'm building — proof that a single mom in Florida with a dream and relentless work ethic can create something extraordinary.

We're just getting started. 💸

title: Why I Went Carnivore — And How It Changed My Energy as a CEO Mom
excerpt: I needed something that would give me energy at 5am, clarity at noon, and still leave fuel in the tank for my daughters at 8pm. The carnivore diet did that.
body:
I know. I know. The first thing people say is: *"But where do you get your fiber?"*

And I smile, because six months ago I was exhausted, brain-fogged, and running three companies on cortisol and iced coffee. Now I wake up at 5am before my daughters, get my workout in, and have clarity that I haven't felt in years.

## What Is the Carnivore Diet?

Simple: meat, eggs, and water. That's essentially it. Some people add butter, some add salt. The premise is that animal products are the most nutrient-dense foods on earth and that many people do better eliminating plants entirely — especially those with autoimmune issues, gut problems, or chronic fatigue.

I'm not here to debate the science. I'm here to tell you what happened to my body.

## The First Two Weeks Were Brutal

I won't sugarcoat it. The adaptation period is rough — headaches, fatigue, crankiness. My body was a sugar-burner and it was not happy about the eviction notice.

By week three, something shifted. The brain fog I'd been carrying like a weighted blanket? Gone. The afternoon energy crash that had me reaching for a third espresso? Gone. I started sleeping deeply instead of anxiously.

## As a Busy Mom and CEO

Running a household with three daughters (one who is 15 months old and still waking up at night) while building three companies requires ENERGY. Not fake energy from stimulants — real, sustained energy.

Carnivore gave me that. I meal prep on Sundays: ground beef, eggs, steak, sometimes chicken. It takes 30 minutes and I'm fueled for the week without decision fatigue around food.

## Should You Try It?

Talk to your doctor. Seriously — this isn't for everyone and I'm not a nutritionist. But if you're chronically exhausted, inflamed, or running on empty, it might be worth investigating.

What I can tell you is that what you put in your body directly determines what you can pour out for your business, your kids, and your vision. 

For me, this was the answer. 🥩✨

title: I Built a Dating App Because I Was Tired of Group Chat Guesswork
excerpt: VIXA was born from one too many nights dissecting a 'lol' text with my girlfriends. Women deserve actual clarity — not just opinions.
body:
You know the scene. Your phone buzzes. You screenshot the text. You send it to four different group chats. Everyone has a different theory. Two hours later you're more confused than when you started, and he's moved on with his evening completely unbothered.

We've all been there. I've been there. And as someone who was already building companies, I thought: *why is there no tool for this?*

That's how VIXA was born.

## What VIXA Actually Does

VIXA is an AI-powered dating clarity app built specifically for women. You paste in a conversation — or upload screenshots — and our AI companion Vela analyzes it. Not in a fluffy, vague way. In a *specific, actionable* way.

Vela reads:
- **Tone** — is he warm, distant, performative?
- **Timing** — response gaps, consistency patterns
- **Word choice** — effort level vs. minimum viable texting
- **Behavioral patterns** — breadcrumbing, love-bombing, genuine interest

She surfaces what's actually happening, scores the overall vibe, flags red flags, and generates reply suggestions that still sound like *you* — not a copied script from a Reddit thread.

## Why This Matters

Women are emotional. That's not a weakness — it's a superpower in most areas of life. But when it comes to analyzing someone who may or may not be wasting your time, emotions can cloud what the data is plainly showing.

VIXA gives you the clarity engine your best friend would be if she had absolutely no filter, perfect memory, and zero judgment.

## What's Coming

VIXA launches first for Apple iPhone with:
- **Free tier**: 10 analyses per week
- **Premium tier**: unlimited analyses, full script library, date-prep briefings, weekly behavioral pattern insights

We're building for the woman who is done wasting emotional energy. She deserves better information. She deserves VIXA.

Coming soon. Early access at [VIXAapp.ai](https://vixaapp.ai) 💗
